title: Card Limit for Credit-Card Payments on Bank-Card Debts, Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Schedule note for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on the card limit of the credit-card ceiling of the day, meaning the card-payment amount the credit-card ceiling starts from, which depends on the debt type and, for a bank-card debt, on the age of the charge-off.

## Rule

The credit-card ceiling's card limit is:
- **$4500.00** for a bank-card debt whose charge-off date is fewer than 730 calendar days before the handling date, or that has no charge-off date;
- **$5500.00** for a bank-card debt whose charge-off date is 730 or more calendar days before the handling date;
- **the stage's rolling 30-day card-payment maximum** for any debt that is not a bank-card debt.

The debt type is the one recorded on the placed account, and the charge-off date is the charge-off or final-bill date recorded on the account. The age is the plain count of calendar days from the charge-off date to the handling date.

## Table

| Debt type on the account | Charge-off date | Card limit |
|---|---|---|
| Bank card | None recorded | $4500.00 |
| Bank card | Fewer than 730 days before the handling date | $4500.00 |
| Bank card | 730 days or more before the handling date | $5500.00 |
| Medical, utility, telecom, auto deficiency, private student loan or retail installment | any | The stage's rolling 30-day card-payment maximum |

## Hypothetical boundary cases

*Handling date 2026-10-10; the accounts are invented.*

| Debt | Charge-off date | Days to the handling date | Card limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bank card | 2024-10-10 | 730 | $5500.00 |
| Bank card | 2024-10-11 | 729 | $4500.00 |
| Bank card | 2025-10-10 | 365 | $4500.00 |
| Bank card, not yet charged off | none | not applicable | $4500.00 |
| Utility | 2022-01-05 | 1739 | The stage's rolling 30-day card-payment maximum |

The two dollar figures are the same at every stage; only the non-bank-card row follows the stage.
